title: PeerStreams
tagline: Twitch of Web3 but more better,Decentralized and with some Analysis
description:
It is a Live Streaming Platform build on Livepeer for content creators , Events , Shows , Live classes and many more.  

Push Usecase:
-> User can Join a Streaamers Channel,See All his Notifications,See all Channels of PUSH , Join/Disjoin a Channel.
-> Streamer can see his Subscriber's ENS and NFT Profile,

Superfluid's Usecase:
-> We believe in Pay as You Watch model so for every second you watch stream ,money is being deducted from your account and deposited into the Streamers Account when you decide to leave the stream.
-> We didn't went with a SUBSCRIPTION model because people generally regret buying a subs or forgets about it .

Covalent's Usecase: 
-> Won't it be awesome if you could know which NFTs does your favourite content creator has in his Wallets .
 -> We also provide analysis about Nft projects and from which chain most of the money streams are coming from and which collections are the streamer trading in past few days/months using Covalent(Beta).
-> We are also Leveraging Covalent to Check if the Streamer has "Stream Tokens",if he has then only he can Stream otherwise he has to wait till he gets Waitlisted.

LivePeer's Usecase :
-> The streamer can stream using Livepeer using the StreamID and the Stream URL which we are generating in our platform and then give that URL and ID to OBS and then the stream will be started.
Why LivePeer ?
-> Startups are consequently compelled to charge their users by selling their data, torment them with adverts, or cease operations altogether.

ENS Usecase :
-> We are Showing all the Wallet Address who are Subscribers of the Streamer and we are not  showing their Wallet Address insted we are showing their ENS names and it's Nft profile Photo.

Web3.storage:
-> We are using Web3.storage to store Thumbnails of Streams,the reason to do this is because you can see your thumbnails even after 50 years of upload and get some memories of old Streams.
-> The Hosted CIDs are stored on Polygon Chain using Solidity Mapping.
how_its_made:
->We tried to Deploy Superfluid on Filecoin VM and Shardeum but due to poor InternetQuality we were not even able to install the Node Modules in one Go.
->The Remix was not able to detect Shardeum network even once after several trials and hence we had to deploy on Polygon for making our Dapp work.
->Filecoin VM is quite new and it was good to explore it with the help of the Mentor .
